title: A telemetry message
description:
Define the message your game sends to its own tools, with a version so both can change.

```
TelemetryV2: magic "XNTL", version 2, frame 5521, player (12.5, 4.0), hp 17, enemies 3
tool built for v1 reads v2: ok (ignores the new field)
tool built for v3 reads v2: missing field -> default
```
hints: New fields always go at the end, so an old reader can stop at the size it knows (lesson 12.06).
`size` is the number of bytes in this message, which tells a newer reader which fields are present.
requirements: A header (magic, version, size) and fixed-width fields; `static_assert` the layout.
Readers accept any version with at least the fields they need, using the size field.
Write the message into bytes and read it back.
stretch: Publish it through shared memory between your game and a separate tool process.
